title: Tartar Sauce
description: Tangy, rich, and briny with capers, chopped cornichons, fresh dill, and lemon zest. The indispensable companion to crisp, golden fried seafood.
whyLove: It turns simple fried fish into something craveable and textured.

title: Fondue
description: A steaming communal caquelon of melted Gruyère AOP and Vacherin Fribourgeois swirled with dry white wine, garlic, and kirsch.
whyLove: Unrushed alpine comfort and the best way to share a cold winter evening with friends.

title: Tartiflette
description: The quintessential Haute-Savoie gratin: tender sliced potatoes, caramelized onions, and smoky lardons drenched in molten Reblochon cheese.
whyLove: Pure mountain indulgence after hours out in the freezing snow.

title: Gazpacho
description: Chilled Andalusian liquid sunshine blended from ripe vine tomatoes, crisp cucumber, bell pepper, garlic, sherry vinegar, and peppery extra-virgin olive oil.
whyLove: Incomparably refreshing when the summer heat is relentless.

title: Chilaquiles
description: Crisp fried corn tortilla quarters lightly bathed in vibrant salsa verde or roasted salsa roja, topped with crema, crumbled queso fresco, onion, and cilantro.
whyLove: The undisputed king of Mexican breakfasts—bold, crunchy, savory, and restorative.

title: IPAs
description: Aromatic, hop-forward ales bursting with citrus zest, damp pine, and a clean, biting bitterness that cuts through anything.
whyLove: That first cold, resinous sip after a long week.

title: Skiing
description: Carving high-speed arcs down fresh corduroy or floating weightlessly through knee-deep backcountry powder amidst crisp mountain air.
whyLove: Total focus and adrenaline where the rest of the world ceases to exist.

title: Padel
description: High-octane rallies, quick-reflex volleys, and three-dimensional geometry off the glass walls in close-quarters doubles play.
whyLove: Addictive, fast-paced tactical fun that never gets repetitive.

title: Sauna
description: Sweating out tension on hot cedar benches in 90°C dry heat, punctuated by the shocking clarity of an ice bath plunge.
whyLove: The deepest physical reset and endorphin rush known to humanity.

title: Steam Baths
description: Dense, enveloping clouds of eucalyptus-infused vapor, soothing muscles and releasing mental chatter in quiet, humid seclusion.
whyLove: A timeless sanctuary of calm that melts away tension.

title: Cold Sunny Days
description: Freezing sub-zero temperatures beneath an unclouded, piercing blue sky, with golden sunlight warming your back through crisp winter air.
whyLove: Invigorating clarity and light that makes everything feel razor-sharp.

title: Kenopsia (Kensopia)
description: The eerie, forlorn atmosphere of a place that is usually teeming with people and noise, but is now quiet, empty, and suspended in time.
whyLove: A haunting poetic stillness found in vacant hallways, off-season resorts, and empty stations.

title: Business Class
description: Lie-flat suites above the clouds, noise-canceling calm, crisp champagne, and waking up refreshed in a new continent.
whyLove: Turning long-haul transit from an exhausting trial into an oasis of quiet productivity and rest.

title: Documentaries
description: Deep-dive investigative journalism, eccentric character portraits, and cinematic chronicles of historical turning points.
whyLove: Reality is always stranger, richer, and more compelling than fiction.

title: Incandescent
description: Emitting light as a result of being heated; glowing with passion, radiant intensity, or luminous brilliance.
whyLove: A word that carries warmth, electricity, and incandescent emotion in its very syllables.

title: Itacate
description: From the Nahuatl 'itacatl'—a provision of food or generous leftovers carefully packed to take on a journey or sent home with guests after a feast.
whyLove: A cultural concept capturing generosity, maternal care, and the continuation of hospitality.

title: Boreal
description: Of or pertaining to the North or northern regions; evocative of subarctic pine forests, cold winds, and aurora borealis.
whyLove: Sounds as crisp, ancient, and evergreen as a subarctic spruce forest.

title: Velleity
description: A mere wish or inclination not strong enough to lead to the slightest action; the faintest, gentlest murmur of volition.
whyLove: A delightfully precise diagnostic term for daydreaming without consequence.

title: Paris
description: Zinc roofs in the rain, corner zinc counters with an espresso, Haussmannian stone, and solitary strolls along the quays of the Seine.
whyLove: A city that rewards aimless wandering better than anywhere else on earth.

title: Amsterdam
description: Rippling canal rings, leaning 17th-century brick facades, bicycle bells, and warm amber light spilling from cozy brown cafés on foggy evenings.
whyLove: Human-scale urbanism, effortless canal reflections, and an unhurried rhythm of life.

title: Costa Alegre
description: Jalisco's dramatic Pacific coastline where emerald jungle mountains plunge directly into wild ocean waves, secluded coves, and golden sunsets.
whyLove: Unspoiled, rugged coastal magic untouched by mass commercialization.

title: Kazbegi
description: The monumental peaks of the High Caucasus mountains and the solitary silhouette of the 14th-century Gergeti Trinity Church perched high beneath Mount Kazbek.
whyLove: Awe-inspiring vertical topography that puts all human concerns in immediate perspective.

title: Svaneti
description: An ancient, isolated alpine region crowned by snowy summits and fortified with thousands of stone medieval defensive towers (koshki).
whyLove: Feels like stepping straight into a medieval highland sanctuary lost in time.
